Run It Cool are experts in temperature-controlled logistics. If you need a reliable chilled courier service in the UK, let us handle your refrigerated deliveries.

Refrigerated Transport for Food & Drink Products
Run It Cool offers reliable refrigerated delivery services, delivering chilled and frozen food and drink products across the UK. With a fleet of multi-temperature vehicles, we can fulfil your chilled courier requirements, whether you are in the city centre or located in rural areas.
Whether you are looking for a regular or nationwide refrigerated delivery service or a same-day emergency courier – you can count on our temperature-controlled logistics services to provide you with the help you require.
Our network currently includes 3 depots in Scotland and England, which allows us to easily provide our chilled delivery service and frozen courier service across the UK. We offer Tri-temp storage and cross-docking facilities to ensure your products are kept within the optimum range at our depots.
Our fleet of professional drivers uses electronic proof of delivery and planning systems. Doing this allows us to give you accurate delivery time windows, ETA updates, instant confirmation of deliveries, and helps to ensure that your items are delivered on time and in temperature. When you choose Run It Cool, you can chill out knowing we are experts in frozen deliveries.
Chilled and Frozen Distribution
We are a van delivery service, delivering chilled & frozen food and drink products across the UK. Our customers come in all shapes and sizes, from specialist products to large food producers, we provide refrigerated transport for range of different businesses with different requirements.
We are contracted to provide multi-drop refrigerated deliveries for a wide range of customers to an array of end customers such as luxury hotels, restaurants, cafes, educational institutes, shops, offices and airports. We offer an overnight collect and drop off service which means your customers can receive product next day

We are committed to reducing our fuel consumption and emissions to give our customers more value for money on delivery charges. We do this by monitoring weight throughout the vehicle as well as during the delivery process.

FAQs About Our Temperature-Controlled Delivery Services
Here are answers to some frequently asked questions to help you better understand how we meet demand and cater to your company’s food transportation needs.
What temperature ranges do refrigerated transport services maintain?
The precise temperatures refrigerated vehicles maintain to protect product freshness, safety and cold chain compliance are as follows:
Chilled food & dairy temperatures range from 0 °C to 5 °C, which is perfect for fresh milk, cheese and ready-to-eat products.
Frozen food is transported at –18 °C or lower, ensuring ice creams, frozen meat and prepped meals stay solid and safe.
For pharmaceuticals, a 2 °C to 8 °C range is ideal for medicines, vaccines and lab samples. Some may require stricter controls depending on regulatory guidelines.
How long can chilled goods remain in transit before quality is affected?
Being the coolest temperature-controlled logistics company in the UK means you never have to worry about your products spoiling on the road.
With properly monitored refrigerated transport, chilled goods are safest when kept between 0 °C and 5 °C:
Most perishables stay fresh for up to 24 hours in transit.
Some high-risk foods may need faster delivery or specially controlled refrigerated vehicles.
We put the right logistics in place to eliminate the chance of mid-transport spoilage, ensuring your goods arrive in peak condition.
Can I get insurance for my refrigerated delivery?
Yes, of course! Insurance is included in our nationwide food courier service because we value quality, comfort, convenience and security.
